description: Write a page's head tags: title, meta description, canonical, Open Graph and the X card, from a title, a description and optionally the page's address, a share image, a site name and an X handle. Answers the HTML, how the Google result would be cut (measured in pixels) and notes on what to fix or improve. Answers from what you send alone: nothing is fetched or stored.

description.description: The meta description: one or two sentences on what the page offers.

noindex.description: Keep the page out of search results.

url.description: The page's own https:// address (canonical and og:url).

name: generate_meta_tags
title: Write a page's meta tags
